Subject: RFP follow-up + incumbent pricing details

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I'm attaching the RFP worksheet and the incumbent (FastInfer) pricing/term sheet so your team can do a side-by-side. Two asks from procurement:

1) Can Redwood match FastInfer's blended unit price for the first 12 months for a 24-month contract? They quoted a material short-term credit this year which is the main driver.
2) We need a clear list of any functional gaps (APIs, streaming behavior, private deployment network controls) that would affect our migration plan.

I've copied procurement. They're looking for a short bulleted response and an ops checklist we can include in the procurement memo by next Tuesday.

Attachments: EdgeCorp_RFP_Sheet.xlsx, FastInfer_Terms_2026.pdf

Regards,

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeCorp pricing sketch + suggested concessions

Kim / team —

I reviewed the FastInfer terms. High level thoughts (for the packet):

- Base match: We can match the blended per-token/unit price for months 1–12 if EdgeCorp commits to a 24-month term and a minimum quarterly usage floor equivalent to the ramp in their RFP. That preserves our unit economics.
- Migration credit: propose $150k one-time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice) + 3 months of free prefix cache for the pilot (to reduce early tokens). This avoids permanent margin hit while addressing their immediate ask.
- Packaging: recommend a two-sku offer — Dedicated Pool (reserved) + Hosted API burst. This mirrors FastInfer's hybrid and gives EdgeCorp rollback options.
- Technical gaps to note: FastInfer currently has a native SSO/JIT connector we don't have as an off-the-shelf product; we can deliver a connector within a 6–8 week professional services engagement (estimate attached in the ops checklist).

I've drafted a short concessions table I'll hand to Kimberly for edits. Marcus, can you confirm the impact on our Q3 revenue recognition and whether $150k onboarding credit is acceptable from finance?

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Director, Solution Pricing
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCorp pricing sketch + suggested concessions

Jonas / Kim —

$150k onboarding credit is doable with two caveats: 1) We need a signed 24-month MSLA and 2) the onboarding credit should be amortized across invoices (finance prefers a 12-month amort schedule for accounting clarity). If procurement insists on upfront deduction, we can convert part of the credit into a professional services prepayment.

Operational note: the SSO/JIT connector delivery will require 3 engineer-weeks of Redwood PS and access to a staging tenant from EdgeCorp. I'll include the PS statement of work high-level scope in the ops checklist.

Also flagging: if we promise cache-free months, that may affect early token reporting—ops needs a short runbook for cache invalidation and quota measurement. Monica, can you own the ops checklist and the runbook?

-marcus
VP, Revenue Operations

Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeCorp pricing sketch + suggested concessions

Kim, Jonas, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the concrete asks. A few clarifications from procurement:

- The FastInfer credit is a $200k one-time deduction applied to the first invoice; they have a 12-month amort policy but the commercial paperwork shows the deduction up front.
- EdgeCorp can do a 24-month MSLA with a quarterly usage floor aligned to the RFP, but we need more detail on the staging access and the SSO delivery timeline to include in our migration plan.

Procurement also asked whether Redwood can commit to a 99.9% availability SLA for Dedicated Pools and what the financial remedies look like. They're also pushing for a two-week termination right in the pilot window if integration isn't feasible.

If you can send a short one-page commercial summary (pricing delta, credits, SLA bullets, termination carve) and a one-page ops checklist with timeline (SSO connector delivery, staging access, runbook owner), procurement will include both in the memo to the legal/compliance committee.

Carl

Carl —

Appreciate the clarity. Action items attached below. Short summary:

- Commercial one-pager (attached): match blended price for months 1–12 under a 24-month MSLA, $200k onboarding credit (amortized over first 12 invoices unless EdgeCorp requires upfront deduction), dedicated pool SLA 99.9% with standard service credits (we've included a sample SLA clause).
- Ops checklist (attached): SSO/JIT connector SOW (6–8 weeks with 3 engineer-weeks from Redwood PS), staging tenant requirements, cache/free prefix details, runbook owner = Monica Patel. Staging access required within 10 business days of PO to meet timeline.
- Pilot termination: we can offer a 14-day pilot rescind clause limited to integration blockers; if rescinded after integration work has begun, a capped PS bill applies (covered in SOW).

Attachments: Redwood_Commercial_OnePager.pdf, EdgeCorp_Ops_Checklist.docx

Next steps: I'll send the one-pager to procurement and legal with your permission to discuss; propose a joint call Monday morning to walk legal through the SLA and the amortization approach.
